summary: Full e2e testing of new features: CSV/Excel import, PDF receipt, demo data seed, benefits workflow. Fixed a critical backend routing bug. All 44 backend tests pass (31 existing + 13 new). All frontend flows verified via Playwright.

critical.issue: Route was defined AFTER GET /members/{mid}, causing FastAPI to match 'import-template' as a member ID → 500 error. FIXED: moved import-template route before the {mid} route.

critical_code_review_comments: FIXED in this iteration: GET /members/import-template was shadowed by GET /members/{mid} due to route ordering in FastAPI. Moved import-template before parameterized routes.

context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features verified: dashboard stats (21 active, ₹7,800 balance), members import (CSV import dialog + template download), contributions (paid/pending status, PDF receipt download button visible), benefits (Mohammed Ashraf committee_approved + Mark Paid button visible), medical aid (Basheer Ibrahim Demo with approved status), cashbook (60 entries with running balance), reports (charts rendering). Import template bug fixed in server.py.
rca_of_issue: FastAPI route ordering bug: When @api_router.get('/members/{mid}') is defined before @api_router.get('/members/import-template'), FastAPI greedily matches 'import-template' as the {mid} path parameter and calls get_member() with mid='import-template'. This causes ObjectId('import-template') to throw an exception → 500. Fix: always place specific literal routes before parameterized routes in FastAPI.
